dataset: OECD ICIO 2026 release (current prices and previous year's prices)

coverage.note: 2023 and 2024 are OECD projected estimations, not observed data. All values are million USD at basic prices unless stated otherwise.

definitions.value_added: Value added at basic prices. The OECD TiVA value-added concept additionally includes net taxes less subsidies on intermediate products (TLS).
definitions.dva_share_incl_tax: Domestic value added plus domestic net tax content, over gross exports. This is the OECD-comparable definition (EXGR_DVA / EXGR_DVASH).
definitions.dva_share_excl_tax: Domestic basic-price value added over gross exports. Excludes net taxes, so it is not directly comparable to published EXGR_DVASH.
definitions.export_growth_volume: Chain-linked volume growth from previous-year-price tables: PYP_t / CP_(t-1) - 1, summed over the sector before growth is computed.
definitions.export_growth_nominal: Year-on-year change in current-price export value. Not a volume measure.
definitions.export_growth_volume_cumulative: Cumulative chain-linked volume growth since 2016, read off the published volume index. 2016 is zero by construction.
definitions.export_growth_nominal_cumulative: Cumulative change in current-price export value since 2016. Comparing this with the cumulative volume series separates a real increase in shipments from a price effect.
definitions.services_share: Value added originating in service industries, embodied in manufacturing exports, over gross manufacturing exports. Services performed inside manufacturing firms are not separately identified.
definitions.domestic_attribution: Value added is attributed by where production happened, not by firm ownership. Domestic value added that is exported, processed abroad and returns still counts as domestic.
